messages:
rachel: quick sync — the console observability examples have a mix of old and new APIs after the export refactor. spotting: `tracehex` vs `trace_id`, `latency_ranges` rename, and a deprecated cost widget field `cost_mode`.

 diego: thanks — do we have a manifest of affected files?

 rachel: gist: https://internal.gists/re/6012-docs-manifest. short summary: ~30 files with trace key, ~10 with latency param, ~6 with cost_mode.

 mei: propose three PRs: tiny link & CDN fixes, API rename + shims, and a docs migration note. low risk split.

 zane: I'll own the CDN/link PR (quick). will also run the preview pipeline after.

 diego: i'll take API rename PR. plan to include a compatibility section with code shims for js/py and a one-liner RFC in the tracehook reference.

 mei: include a linter to catch `cost_mode` usage in examples/ and fail CI if present. small script: `rg -n "cost_mode" examples/ || true` and fail on count>0.

 docs-bot: scan results: 31 files reference `trace_id`; 9 files use `latency_buckets`; 6 files reference `cost_mode`. no credentials found.

 zane: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8300 (links) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8301 (cost cleanup).

 diego: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8302 (trace/latency rename + shims + migration note). added CLI check: `rg "trace_id|latency_buckets|cost_mode" -n examples/` to PR description.

 rachel: merge order: links first, then trace PR, then cost cleanups. target: links within 24h, others later this week. i'll monitor preview and post results.

 mei: follow-up: create issue to add headless rendering smoke tests to catch palette and widget regressions.

 docs-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4400 - "Headless rendering smoke tests for console observability examples".
